title: Compare a capped low-occupation transfer with the arbitrary-occupancy bound
statement: With P=span(a,b), diagonalPHP and||PHQ||<=Omega, exact transfer has AT>=2/Omega^2 for any Q dimension. If q(t)<=eps<1, projected-ray Fubini–Study distance yields AT>=pi^2(1-eps)/(4Omega^2).

Dipole formulas are free-space point-dipole Born–Markov/RWA estimates with paid exchange, not a universal device constraint.

body: Remove local endpoint phases. Euclidean endpoint distance sqrt2 proves the uncapped bound; the normalized projected ray has speed<=Omega sqrt(q/(1-q)), proving the capped bound by Cauchy–Schwarz. A direct a-b coupling violates the hypothesis. These are exposure-time inequalities, not closed-continuum emission bounds.
